_comment: Project-local lint aliases. The architecture artefact is the bundled context/architecture.html (with editable source in context/arch/); the legacy markdown architecture.md was retired into it on 2026-06-25. tmodloader/ is per-API reference content; integration/ is cross-cutting reference content; perf-pass/ is the v0.5-v0.6 performance-research record. All three are intentional structural additions documented in _Overview.md's folder map. _Overview.md is the entry-point file (folder map + reading order) that lives alongside the architecture explorer; it is aliased into the architecture slot so the lint accepts it as a canonical top-level file.
